COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1236 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Additional C.S.C. 
for the State.
3. Mr. Shobhit Joshi, learned counsel holding brief of 
Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for respondent No.3, 
through video conferencing.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioners 
that in the similar set of controversy, this Court has passed 
interim order on 13.06.2024 in WPSS No.316 of 2024. 
Since, the controversy involved in the present writ petition 
is identical, interim order can be passed in this petition.
5. Learned State Counsel as well as learned counsel for 
respondent no.3 has not disputed the said submission made 
by the learned counsel for the petitioners. However learned 
counsel for the respondent no. 03 apprised the court that 
result of the selection is underway.
6. List this case on 06.11.2024. 
7. Till next date of listing, the respondents are 
restrained from interfering in functioning of the petitioners 
to the post of Junior Engineer.
8. In the meantime, respondents may file counter 
affidavit, if any. 
9. Interim relief application (IA/1/2024) stands 
disposed of accordingly.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 12.07.2024

6. Interim order, if any, is extended till the next date 
of listing.

disposed of.
